Distribution and published records: The species was described by Švihla (1983) from Southern Iran and then reported also for Oman (Gizan, 1926, Fernandez lgt.), Saudi Arabia and Yemen (Švihla, 2004) and United Arab Emirates (Švihla, 2008, Kubisz, 2020). Notes. Individuals of this species are attracted to light. Examples of the habitat of this species can be seen in Fig. 5 b and 5 d.

Distribution in Iran. Ardabil (Modarres Awal 1987 as Piezodorus pallescens (Germar, 1837 )), East Azarbaijan (Modarres Awal 1997 b as P. pallescens), Kerman (Hoberlandt 1997 as P. pa l l e s ce n s), Sistan & Baluchestan (Hoberlandt 1959 as P. pallescens), Iran (no locality cited) (Rider 2006). General distribution. Africa, Iran, Saudi Arabia. Host plant. On sainfoin (Fabaceae) (Modarres Awal 1997 b).
Distribution in the Arabian Peninsula: Saudi Arabia (Boni Bartalucci 1997, 2016). Extralimital distribution: Egypt, Iran, Jordan, Morocco (Boni Bartalucci 1997), Israel (Boni Bartalucci 1997, 2016).
